applies_to: go-eCharger wallboxes running firmware 0.40 or newer with the v1 API (Modbus TCP API v1 document version 1.0, 2020-10-01).
summary: The go-eCharger wallbox exposes a Modbus TCP server over WLAN once API access is enabled in the app. This map covers the single-register status and control points: charging state, errors, charge permission, access mode, cable lock, current setpoints and the push-button current levels.

addressing.note: The document says register IDs are 0-indexed and some clients must add 1. The table numbers are wire addresses: AMPERE_VOLATILE 299 is request address 299 (holding register 40300 in 1-based tools).

source.title: GO-E Charger Modbus TCP/IP Documentation English
source.doc_number: go-eCharger Modbus TCP API v1 EN, version 1.0

notes: The v1 document does not name which charger hardware generations it covers; check the API version against your charger's firmware.
Official go-e documentation hosted in the goecharger GitHub organisation.

Left out: all 32-bit values (voltages, currents, power, energy, power factor). The document only says the 16-bit registers are big-endian and does not state which register of a pair holds the high word, so the word order is not established.
Left out: firmware version, MAC, serial number, host name and network addresses (ASCII/binary blocks).
The source spells register 213 'AMLERE_L2'; it is listed here as AMPERE_L2.

registers.name: CAR_STATE
registers.description: Charging state as seen on the PWM pilot.

registers.name: PP_CABLE
registers.description: Type 2 cable current coding: 13-32 A, 0 = no cable.

registers.name: ERROR
registers.description: Error code.

registers.name: ADAPTER_INPUT
registers.description: Adapter fitted to the charger.

registers.name: UNLOCKED_BY
registers.description: Number of the RFID card that started this charge.

registers.name: PHASES
registers.description: Phase presence before/after the contactor.

registers.name: ALLOW
registers.description: Whether the PWM charging signal is allowed.

registers.name: ACCESS_STATE
registers.description: Access control mode.

registers.name: LED_BRIGHTNESS
registers.description: 0 = off, 255 = maximum.

registers.name: LED_SAVE_ENERGY
registers.description: LEDs switch off automatically after 10 s when on.

registers.name: ELECTRICITY_PRICES_HOURS
registers.description: Minimum hours to charge in electricity-price mode.

registers.name: ELECTRICITY_PRICES_FINISHED
registers.description: Hour of day by which price-mode charging must be done.

registers.name: ELECTRICITY_PRICES_ZONE
registers.description: aWATTar price zone.

registers.name: AMPERE_MAX
registers.description: Upper limit for the current setting.

registers.name: AMPERE_L1
registers.description: Push-button current level 1: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L2
registers.description: Push-button current level 2: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L3
registers.description: Push-button current level 3: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L4
registers.description: Push-button current level 4: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L5
registers.description: Push-button current level 5: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: NORWAY_MODE
registers.description: Disables ground detection; for IT networks only.

registers.name: AMPERE_VOLATILE
registers.description: Charge current 6-32 A, not saved; use for energy management.

registers.name: AMPERE_EEPROM
registers.description: Charge current 6-32 A, saved to EEPROM (about 100,000 writes).

integration.summary: Connect to port 502, unit 1. Read CAR_STATE (100) and ERROR (107), allow charging with ALLOW (200) and set the current with AMPERE_VOLATILE (299) for dynamic load management.
integration.enable: Allow API access in the go-eCharger app under Advanced Settings, then restart the charger. Needs firmware 0.40 or newer.
quirks: Unit ID is 1 and the port is 502 over WLAN.
setup: Enable API access in the app (Advanced Settings) and reboot the charger.
Connect to the charger IP on TCP port 502, unit ID 1.
gotchas: Use AMPERE_VOLATILE (299) for frequent changes; AMPERE_EEPROM (300) is stored in EEPROM with roughly 100,000 write cycles.
AMPERE_VOLATILE resets to the stored EEPROM value at the next boot.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
